import re, importlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/work')
import textmask
importlib.reload(textmask)

def old_masked(text, name):
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

cases = [
    ("Auto-K Server handles AUTO-K requests", "auto-k"),
    ("Fowler Refactoring skill for FOWLER-REFACTORING tasks", "fowler-refactoring"),

    ("short a-b tokens should be skipped: a b ab", "a-b"),
    ("", "x-y-z"),
    ("Name Name-Part namepart", "name-part"),
]

all_ok = True
for text, name in cases:
    o = old_masked(text, name)
    n = textmask.masked(text, name)
    ok = o == n
    all_ok &= ok
    print(repr(text), repr(name), "->", repr(n), "match:", ok)

# check name_tokens directly
print(textmask.name_tokens("auto-k"))
print(textmask.name_tokens("fowler-refactoring"))
print("ALL OK:", all_ok)
